definitions.gloss: absent-mindedly; spaced out; in a daze
definitions.explanation: Describes being mentally unfocused, zoning out, or not paying attention.
Describes something appearing unclear or indistinct.

examples.japanese: ぼーっと⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ぼーっと⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm so tired I can't focus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぼーっと⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was spaced out during class.
I was staring absently out the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひいて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼーっと⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have a cold and my head feels foggy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠|とお}く→遠く：01680_tooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼーっと⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぼーっとしか⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{明|あ}かり→明かり：01681_akari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼーっと⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぼーっと⟦{人影|ひとかげ}→人影：16212_hitokage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could vaguely see a figure in the darkness.

examples.english: When I take off my glasses, everything looks blurry.

notes:
ぼーっと is an onomatopoeic word describing mental or visual haziness. The two senses are related: both convey a lack of sharpness or focus.

Sense 1 (mental): Describes being spaced out, absent-minded, or unable to concentrate. ぼーっと⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is extremely common in daily conversation.

Sense 2 (visual): Describes something appearing blurry, hazy, or indistinct — like shapes in fog or dim light.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぼーっと⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to space out, zone out
- ぼーっと⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to stare blankly
- ぼーっと⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time idly
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼーっと⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: head feels foggy

TYPICAL CAUSES:
- ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧ (tiredness)
- ⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧ (lack of sleep)
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧ (cold/illness)
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{事|ごと}→考え事：noentry⟧ (lost in thought)

Note: ぼーっと⟦するな→する：00392_suru⟧ is a common scolding expression meaning "Pay attention!" or "Stop daydreaming!"
